messages:
Lina P: hey team, I'm in my first week and trying to get set up with observability for the inference service. followed the onboarding checklist but getting a 403 on Datadog and Grafana returns a signin loop. SSO is lina.p@redwood.ai

devex-bot: welcome @Lina P! please post your email and the exact dashboards/projects you need. docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/observability-onboard. If it's urgent, tag @Infra Ops. :wave:

Lina P: thanks — email is lina.p@redwood.ai. need access to grafana folder "inference" and the Datadog logs for inference-prod. also would like Sentry access for inference-runtime-prod if that's a separate proj.

Chris M: hey @Lina P, two quick things to try first: 1) open an incognito window to rule out stale cookies, 2) check your Okta groups page to confirm you're in redwood-observability. If both look fine, i'll kick a SCIM sync.

Lina P: incognito still hits signin loop. okta shows me in redwood-observability and in engineers group.

Chris M: thanks. i'm going to force a SCIM provisioning sync for lina.p@redwood.ai and push a manual Grafana ACL update. give me ~3m.

SRE Oncall: FYI identity service had an intermittent token cache bug this morning that caused webui redirects. i cleared the cache at 10:12am UTC. if you're still blocked after Chris' sync ping me.

Infra Ops: added lina.p@redwood.ai to grafana-viewers and datadog-log-read. You should get an email invite for Grafana; Sentry access requires a project invite from the owners (i'll check who owns inference-runtime-prod).

Lina P: grafana invite came through and dashboards render now — can see cpu/latency panels. Datadog still 403 when I open the log explorer.

Chris M: odd. can you run this quick curl from your machine and paste the response code?

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \ 
  -H "DD-API-KEY: <use-your-workspace-token>" \ 
  "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/logs-queries/list"
```

Lina P: returns 403. i didn't add the api key; was instructed to test with our workspace token from the vault.

Chris M: that's consistent — I see the provisioning sync completed but your Datadog role is still pending in the identity service. I'll temp-add you to datadog-readers while the backfill runs. give it ~2m.

Infra Ops: Sentry owner for inference-runtime-prod is @infra-observability. sent an invite to lina.p@redwood.ai for that project.

Lina P: Datadog works now, and Sentry invite accepted. thanks! quick question: who do I contact to propose a panel tweak on the inference latency chart? want to add p95 and p99 lines.

Infra Ops: small display tweaks can be requested in the #observability-dashboards channel or open a PR against the dashboards repo (repos/infrastructure/grafana-dashboards). add exported JSON and a short description. For production-level changes, coordinate with @infra-observability for alert implications.

Lina P: perfect — i'll open a small PR. thanks everyone for the speedy help :heart:
